decisions.reason: The address autocomplete web service builds directly on the firm's established web services and data assets, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
The Austrian gas grid fee database extends the firm's existing gas fee database expertise to a neighbouring market, so the firm can assimilate and learn from early results.
Peak load window determination draws on the firm's existing analytical know-how and process expertise, allowing the firm to apply its related knowledge.
The end-customer tariff database leverages the firm's existing tariff and database capabilities, enabling the firm to learn from and improve the offering.
Custom web services build on the firm's established web services and software development, so the firm can absorb feedback and refine the service.
The postal code lookup service uses the firm's existing address and data services, so the firm can interpret early results and is likely to retain it.
